title: Sparkly popsicle
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='ice1' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff7eb9'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#ff4d94'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d63070'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='stick' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#f0c070'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c0884a'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- stick -->
  <rect x='45' y='62' width='11' height='30' rx='5' fill='url(#stick)'/>
  <rect x='47' y='64' width='3' height='24' rx='1.5' fill='#fbe0b0' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- popsicle body -->
  <rect x='26' y='14' width='48' height='52' rx='16' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <rect x='28' y='16' width='44' height='48' rx='14' fill='url(#ice1)'/>

  <!-- shine highlight -->
  <rect x='34' y='22' width='8' height='28' rx='4' fill='#ffd0e4' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='24' r='3' fill='#fff0f6' opacity='0.9'/>

  <!-- dripping edge near stick -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='62' r='4' fill='#ff4d94'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='63' r='3.5' fill='#ff4d94'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#fff3a0'>
    <path d='M18 20 l2.2 5.2 5.2 2.2 -5.2 2.2 -2.2 5.2 -2.2 -5.2 -5.2 -2.2 5.2 -2.2 z'/>
    <path d='M84 34 l1.6 3.8 3.8 1.6 -3.8 1.6 -1.6 3.8 -1.6 -3.8 -3.8 -1.6 3.8 -1.6 z'/>
    <path d='M76 78 l1.4 3.3 3.3 1.4 -3.3 1.4 -1.4 3.3 -1.4 -3.3 -3.3 -1.4 3.3 -1.4 z'/>
    <path d='M20 70 l1.4 3.3 3.3 1.4 -3.3 1.4 -1.4 3.3 -1.4 -3.3 -3.3 -1.4 3.3 -1.4 z'/>
    <circle cx='86' cy='60' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='14' cy='46' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='90' cy='14' r='2'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#ffffff'>
    <circle cx='30' cy='88' r='1.6'/>
    <circle cx='68' cy='90' r='1.6'/>
    <circle cx='92' cy='84' r='1.4'/>
    <circle cx='8' cy='90' r='1.4'/>
  </g>
</svg>
